query:
SELECT lpad(n::text, 4, '0') AS "code!"
        FROM generate_series($1::integer, 9999) AS n
        WHERE NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM reserved_pdn_codes WHERE code = lpad(n::text, 4, '0')
        ) AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM players WHERE event_id = $2 AND pdn_code = lpad(n::text, 4, '0')
        )
        ORDER BY n
        LIMIT 1
